prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Katy, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1427; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the collision at the intersection in Katy, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Can you tell me in your own words what happened?

A: I was driving through the intersection on a green light. The other car came from my right side and didn't stop for their red light. They hit the passenger side of my car pretty hard.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt at the time?

A: Yes, I was. The airbags deployed on my side, though, and I hit my left knee on the door frame and the center console.

Q: Did you notice any warning signs before the impact, like the other vehicle slowing or honking?

A: No. I didn't see them until they were already in the intersection. I had maybe a second to react.

Q: Where do you feel pain right now?

A: My left knee is the worst. It's swollen and I can't fully straighten it. I also have some stiffness in my neck and lower back.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or gone to an urgent care facility since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same afternoon. They took X-rays and said there was no fracture, but they referred me to an orthopedic specialist for an MRI because of the swelling and instability.

Q: Did you have any problems with that knee before this accident?

A: No, not that I can recall. I play recreational softball and I've never had any issues with it.

Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the collision or your injuries?

A: Only that I'm still having trouble walking up stairs, and I've missed a few days of work because of it. I'm happy to provide the medical records.

Q: Thank you. We'll follow up with you once we've reviewed everything.

A: Okay, thank you.
